B) Keep USD 3,200 as unapplied credit on the account and issue a statement of unapplied credit (we will leave suspense GL 1120 and provide a credit note GE-CN-0327).
C) Reverse the partial posting and repost correctly if GreenEdge can supply a corrected bank trace that includes the invoice suffix.
